keyEvidence: V4 recovered 1467 exact events and reduced event FN by 1467 versus V3.
V4 simultaneously added 8772 event FP, 1437 fragmented reference runs, and worsened onset-only F1.
Pitch-correct wrong-string errors improved by 686, so reference-aware routing should be retained.
P2->P1 scales improved strongly while chords added 5061 FP, proving the residual failure is content-dependent rather than one global threshold error.
Frozen V4 macro F1 remained 0.243523; decoder/objective-only changes show diminishing returns.

externalResearchBasis.concept: Temporal recurrent modeling after TabCNN-style acoustic features
externalResearchBasis.rationale: Published guitar-tab research reports improved tablature recall/F1 when recurrent temporal context is added to a framewise TabCNN-style system.
externalResearchBasis.useInV5: single-layer causal GRU over learned TabCNN acoustic embeddings

externalResearchBasis.rationale: Onsets-and-Frames-style transcription separates event starts from sustained activity instead of forcing one frame classifier to solve both.
externalResearchBasis.useInV5: dedicated six-string onset head plus separate six-string activity head

externalResearchBasis.rationale: Recent guitar-transcription systems use auxiliary pitch/activity estimates to improve final string/fret routing.
externalResearchBasis.useInV5: 44-bin multi-pitch head whose soft probabilities condition the final state head

architecture.acousticBackbone: Pinned TabCNN convolutional stack only; published/random pretrained weights are not loaded.

temporalModel.reason: Adds learned temporal state while allowing deterministic streaming inference and bounded public-CPU cost.

auxiliaryHeads.onset: 6 binary logits, one per physical string
auxiliaryHeads.activity: 6 binary logits, one per physical string

finalStateHead.routingInput: GRU hidden state concatenated with soft onset, activity, and pitch probabilities
finalStateHead.intent: Separate event admission, sustained activity, pitch evidence, and final physical-string/fret routing.

inputRepresentation.reason: Isolate the architectural hypothesis before changing both model and representation.

stateCrossEntropy.reason: Back off V4's 1.30 global active pressure now that activity/onset have dedicated heads.

referenceAwarePitchEquivalentIdentityMar.semantics: Preserve the V4 repair: never penalize MASK or a legitimate same-pitch reference note on another string.

decoder.reason: Recovered activity may continue without repeated onset evidence, but every new event/state transition is explicitly onset-gated to attack chord over-generation.

syntheticVerificationRequirements: Exact pinned TabCNN convolutional source is used.
V5 output head shapes are exact.
All four supervised tasks and learned task weights receive finite gradients.
GRU propagates prior-frame context into later state predictions.
State/activity evidence alone cannot create a new event without onset evidence.
A valid onset can initiate an event which activity/state evidence then sustains without repeated onset.
A fret change requires new onset evidence.
Singleton event suppression and same-fret gap cleanup remain bounded.
Reference-aware same-pitch routing semantics remain correct.
Uninterrupted and serialized-resumed V5 optimization are bit-exact for model, optimizer and Python/NumPy/Torch RNG state.
nextGate: Dedicated V5 exact-runtime synthetic verification must pass before the user's V5 real-run authorization can be activated.
